identity.body: One unique OZ ID per player, backed by step-by-step identity verification.

protection.title: Minors protected
protection.body: The legal guardian decides on profile visibility and every contact request.

network.title: Trusted connections
network.body: Only verified organisations can view profiles, with rights set role by role.

profiles.title: Who is it for?
profiles.lead: OZ Football ID serves everyone in football, with rights suited to each.

joueur.title: Player
joueur.lead: Your football identity, verified and free, for life.
joueur.p1: A unique OZ ID, never reassigned, and a card to share.
joueur.p2: A verified profile: identity and age checked, “Verified profile” badge.
joueur.p3: Discovered by verified clubs and scouts, without ever paying.

tuteur.title: Legal guardian
tuteur.lead: You stay in control of your minor child's profile.
tuteur.p1: Nothing is published without your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
tuteur.p2: You see who viewed the profile, with the organisation's name.
tuteur.p3: Nobody receives their contact details: every contact goes through you or their club.

academie.title: Academy
academie.lead: Follow your players and get their training recognised.
academie.p1: An up-to-date roster linked to verified identities.
academie.p2: Import your existing players without retyping.
academie.p3: A search suited to training, without physical criteria.

club.title: Club
club.lead: Recruit on verified identities and ages.
club.p1: Search by position, age, strong foot, region and verification level.
club.p2: Profiles watermarked with your name, every view traced.
club.p3: Followed players and exports within the limits of your plan.

federation.title: Federation
federation.lead: A reliable overview of registered players, read-only.
federation.p1: Indicators aggregated by region and age group.
federation.p2: Verified identities to fight age fraud.
federation.p3: A tailored offer, with no direct contact with players.

centre.title: OZ Performance centre
centre.lead: Certify performance measured on the pitch.
centre.p1: The OZ ID is scanned at the start of each session: no identity mix-up.
centre.p3: Tests and in-session entry arrive with Phase 2.

recruteur.title: Scout
recruteur.lead: Discover talent without doubting their identity.
recruteur.p1: Profiles whose identity and age are verified.
recruteur.p2: Access to minor players reserved for verified scouts.
recruteur.p3: Every view of a minor is visible to their guardian: trust works both ways.

about.title: About OZ Football ID
about.lead: OZ Football ID gives every football player a verified sporting identity, unique and for life.
about.problem: Without a reliable record, a young player's age and identity are doubted, and their talent goes unnoticed. False promises target minors first.
about.answer: A free OZ ID for every player, identity verification carried out by the OZ team, and strict rules: a minor is visible only with their guardian's consent, and only to verified organisations.
about.p1: A player never has to pay to exist and be discovered.
about.p2: No minor's contact details are ever shared with anyone.
about.p3: No data is sold; no targeted advertising.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Players are always free. Organisations choose the plan that fits their size.
pricing.provisional: Indicative prices, subject to change: no payment is possible yet.
pricing.annual: Annual subscription: 12 months for the price of 10.

desc.playerFree: OZ ID, profile, verified badge, OZ ID card, discovery by organisations
desc.playerPremium: Highlighting in results, advanced statistics (coming soon)
